name: fathom-mcp
description: Connect Codex to Fathom AI Notetaker meetings, transcripts, summaries, teams, and webhooks through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Use Fathom AI Notetaker data from Codex.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin with a local MCP server for Fathom AI Notetaker. It can list meetings, retrieve recording summaries and transcripts, inspect teams and members, create or delete webhooks, and verify webhook signatures.
defaultPrompt: Get the transcript for this Fathom recording.
Create a Fathom webhook for meeting summaries.
